bullets.text: GitHub Copilot SDK Launched - **Microsoft** enhances developer productivity by embedding work context into coding tools.
Securing AI Agents - **Microsoft Defender** introduces real-time protection for AI agents to mitigate security risks.
Windows 365 for Agents - **Microsoft** expands Cloud PC capabilities to run autonomous AI agents securely.
AI in Azure Storage - **Microsoft** focuses on optimizing Azure Storage for AI workloads and enhancing performance.
Windows App Development CLI - **Microsoft** unveils winapp to streamline Windows application development processes.
Integrated Security Success - **Microsoft** highlights how integrated security frameworks drive AI transformation in enterprises.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - **Microsoft** releases new features and fixes in the latest Windows 11 Insider build.
Phishing Campaign Discovered - **Microsoft Defender** uncovers a multi-stage phishing campaign exploiting SharePoint.
Notepad and Paint Updates - **Microsoft** rolls out enhancements for Notepad and Paint apps for Windows Insiders.
Xbox App for Arm PCs - **Microsoft** expands Xbox app availability to Arm-based Windows 11 PCs for gamers.
